about.heading: About
about.body: I'm a final-year BSc (Hons) IT student at SLIIT with hands-on experience across full-stack and microservices development. My work spans banking backend systems, event-driven architecture with Kafka, and full MERN-stack platforms — I care about building things that hold up outside a classroom, not just demo well once.
